title: Express and Node hosting
summary: Keep your Express server, Prometheus metrics, tracing, authentication, and deployment policies.

sections.title: Middleware ownership
sections.body: Smolter does not start a listening server or depend on Express. createRequestHandler is a Node-compatible middleware function. Mount metrics, tracing, authentication, request limits, and static assets in your existing Express app before it. Mount error-handling middleware afterward. Do not put express.json() or express.urlencoded() before Smolter routes: the adapter reads the original request body for route actions.

sections.title: Build contract
sections.body: Pass the server entry module as build. It exports default(request, entry) for documents and handleDataRequest(request) for loaders/actions. entry is the browser entry URL from the Vite manifest, including your deployment base. For the application integration, enable build.manifest in your browser Vite config, then build the server entry separately.
sections.code:
vite build --outDir dist/client --manifest
vite build --ssr src/entry.server.tsx --outDir dist/server

sections.title: Requests, cookies and failures
sections.body: The adapter forwards methods, headers, bodies and abort signals; dispatches /path.__smolter to the data handler; and sends the Response status, headers and body. Invalid data targets return 400. Rejected handlers reach Express next(error). Express req.protocol is respected, so configure trust proxy according to your own ingress policy rather than blindly trusting forwarded headers. Multiple Set-Cookie headers are preserved. In development, the existing adapter removes Secure from outgoing cookies for local HTTP.

sections.title: Entry files
sections.body: Your metrics and tracing middleware wraps the SSR/action handler. Node helpers stream Response bodies with backpressure and flush compression middleware when supported. Keep proxies configured to permit streaming. Server code stays in server-only subpaths.

sections.title: Multiple applications on one origin
sections.body: Route-local transport preserves application prefixes: /admin/users.__smolter dispatches /admin/users. Mount the correct application and authentication middleware for both document and data paths. Reserve the suffix before static fallbacks. Existing Express endpoints at /admin/users remain separate. Explicit dataEndpoint retains the legacy query transport for migration.

sections.title: Request security
sections.body: Since 0.5.2, mutations accept POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE only. Other unsafe methods return 405 before actions run. An Origin must exactly match the request URL origin; opaque or foreign origins and Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site return 403. Headerless server clients remain supported. Authentication, authorization and CSRF tokens remain application responsibilities. Behind a reverse proxy, construct the Request with the public URL or configure Express protocol/trust proxy for your trusted proxy only. Smolter does not trust forwarded headers automatically. Enforce body-size and request-time limits before handing the raw stream to Smolter; do not consume it with a body parser.
